reviews.review_description: Love this game to be able to look out of the tower in vr is so good, graphics are good as are the models. Fun game and worth the money if you love atc games. I look forward to see if they release extra models like freight options 747  and other airports. It will be interesting, that said its worth the money now so go get it.

I played a demo 2/3 years ago and it’s been well worth the wait to play this game. Standing in the control tower with a super environment around you is a great VR experience. Looking forward to future developments.
